line.a_ziew.text: Yawn... I slept so well. Is it morning yet?

line.a_ciemno.text: I don't know. Underground it's always dark, and I can't see very well.

line.a_dzien_dobry.text: Good morning, Mole! Get up, it's morning already!

line.a_noc.text: Morning? I thought it was always night.

line.a_na_gore.text: Come up with us! We'll show you how a whole day goes by: morning, midday, evening and night.

line.b_jasno.text: Oh, how bright! The sun is rising.

line.b_rano.text: Yes, it's morning. In the morning we get up, wash and eat breakfast.

line.b_co_rano.text: What do we do in the morning? Point to it.

line.b_co_rano_nie.text: We do that in the evening. In the morning we eat breakfast.

line.b_caly_dzien.text: The day goes by in order: in the morning the sun rises, at midday it's high, in the evening it sets, and at night the moon shines.

line.b_uloz.text: Put the pictures in order, from morning to night. Start at the arrow.

line.zla_kolejnosc.text: That's not its place. What comes earlier, and what later?

line.zla_kolejnosc.wiewiorka.text: That's not its place. What comes earlier, and what later?

line.b_po_kolei.text: Morning, midday, evening, night. The whole day in order!

line.c_wieczor.text: It's getting darker. Is it night already?

line.c_zgubil.text: Not yet, it's evening. Oh dear, little Hedgehog is lost. It got dark and he hid in the bushes.

line.c_poswiec.text: Let's shine a light. Point to a bush, and we'll see if he's there.

line.c_pusto.text: He's not here. Shine on another bush.

line.c_jest.text: There he is! Little Hedgehog is found.

line.c_noc_swietliki.text: Now it's night! Look, fireflies. Catch a firefly, point to it.

line.c_juz_wiem.text: Now I know! After the morning comes midday, after midday the evening, after the evening the night, and after the night the morning again.

line.c_dobranoc.text: Bravo, Mole! Now let's go to bed.

line.p_start.text: Let's play with the times of day! I have five games.

line.p_co_dalej.text: Morning, midday, evening... and what comes next? Point to it.

line.p_co_dalej_nie.text: After the evening it gets dark. What comes after the evening?

line.p_noc.text: Yes, after the evening comes the night.

line.p_w_nocy.text: What do we do at night? Point to it.

line.p_w_nocy_nie.text: We do that in the morning. At night we sleep.

line.p_spimy.text: At night we sleep in bed.

line.p_trzy.text: Put the pictures in order, start at the arrow.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find pairs: morning with morning, night with night.

line.p_po_nocy.text: And what comes after the night? Point to it.

line.p_po_nocy_nie.text: The evening comes before the night. After the night the sun rises.

line.p_rano_znowu.text: Yes! After the night it's morning again.

line.d_wieczor.text: It's evening. Time to get ready for bed.

line.d_uloz.text: What do we do in order? First a bath, then pyjamas, then a story, and last the bed. Put the pictures in order, start at the arrow.

line.d_dobranoc.text: A bath, pyjamas, a story and sleep. Good night, friends!

line.d_rodzice.text: Tell your parents what happened this morning, at midday and this evening.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for showing me a whole day! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the night with the moon. Mole gave it to us when we learnt the times of day in order.
